title: Foundations of Cell and Molecular Biology
description: From molecular structure to cell behavior: build a mechanistic model of how living systems store information, capture energy, and maintain boundaries.

modifications: Normalized the course title to Foundations of Cell and Molecular Biology; the stable ID is unchanged.

outcomes.description: Use free-energy and enzyme models to reason about cellular reactions.
Trace information flow from DNA to phenotype.
Interpret controls and evidence in a simple molecular experiment.

lesson_objectives.description: Distinguish covalent structure from molecular interactions.
Predict how charge, polarity, and hydrophobicity shape biomolecular assembly.
Use electrochemical gradients to determine passive ion movement.
Separate simple diffusion, facilitated diffusion, and active transport.
Interpret Michaelis-Menten parameters without confusing affinity and rate.
Relate ΔG to equilibrium and coupling.
Trace DNA information through transcription and translation.
Identify the purpose of positive, negative, and loading controls.

workload.basis: Not measured. Legacy nominal credit and display-time labels are not retained as workload estimates.

lessons.title: Molecular structure and noncovalent forces
lessons.worked_example: A phospholipid has a charged or polar headgroup and nonpolar acyl chains. In water, the hydrophobic effect favors bilayers with the tails shielded; it does not require a special covalent bond between lipids.

lessons.title: Membranes, transport, and compartmentalization
lessons.worked_example: For a neutral solute with equal concentrations on both sides, net diffusive flux is zero even if molecules continue crossing in both directions.

lessons.title: Enzymes and cellular energetics
lessons.worked_example: If [S] = Km, the model predicts v = Vmax/2. Doubling enzyme concentration doubles Vmax but leaves Km unchanged in the simple model.

lessons.title: Gene expression and experimental logic
lessons.worked_example: In a knockdown experiment, a non-targeting RNA control tests for delivery or off-target effects; a rescue with a perturbation-resistant construct strengthens causal attribution.

grading_policy.attempt_policy: Unlimited formative retries; no summative grade is awarded.
grading_policy.solution_release: Public practice solutions may be shown after an attempt. They are not production exam keys.
grading_policy.late_policy: No deadlines or late penalties exist in this partial package.
grading_policy.appeals: No instructor review workflow is implemented; report ambiguous practice items to repository maintainers.

accessibility.diagram_policy: The seed package contains no imported diagrams; newly authored diagrams require descriptions and individual license tracking.
known_issues: Unicode equations require structured mathematical alternatives and assistive-technology review.
